review.assessment: The change adds a single conditional re-normalization step inside `summarise()`. When every reading in the batch exceeds the acceptable range, it divides each value by 10 and re-runs `alerts.out_of_range()` before deciding whether to raise `AlertStorm` or proceed. This correctly intercepts the systematic scale-factor error (likely Pa-to-cKPa mismatch) that was triggering false alert storms, without altering report line shapes or touching `data/`.
